answer: Each agent can earn influence only by posting a bond that is slashed if its messages are proven to violate the protocol, while voting weight grows with bond age rather than account count. A sybil attacker must therefore lock substantial capital across many identities and keep it exposed long enough to gain sway; splitting one stake among fresh accounts does not multiply weight. Even a campaign spanning tundra, marble, and reef communities pays this cost, and detected abuse destroys the bonded funds.
